comment: Params 8, 9, 10 and 11, the four trim knobs under the Div A and Div B controls, are left with no line: computeDivisorSub in composites/Sub.h is called with the divisor knob passed as both the knob and the trim, so these four params are never read and the subharmonic tune CV is scaled by the divisor knob instead. Param 27 is the AGC menu setting and has no control on the panel. The V/OCT input is continuous with the quantizer scale off, which is how it comes up (Sub.h:376 and SimpleQuantizer.h:10-16); choosing a scale makes it stepped.
